name: Influence
description_en:
Influence at influence.so is an AI-assisted social publishing workspace for creators and small businesses. It combines brand guidance, channel-specific drafts, campaigns, media, a calendar and delivery results. It is distinct from similarly named influencer-marketing or website social-proof products. The documented workflow lets a person review prepared content before a confirmed publish or schedule action.

Its differentiating evaluation question is whether the same content can be safely prepared in the web workspace or a connected assistant while keeping the exact accounts, media and dates visible. Influence IQ planning, publication allowances and AI scheduling capacity are separate mechanisms. A conversation ending does not cancel a saved schedule, and one account’s publication result does not establish every destination succeeded. This research reviewed public documentation without connecting an account or running a send.
description_zh:
influence.so 的 Influence 是面向创作者、小企业的 AI 辅助社交发布工作区，结合品牌指南、渠道草稿、活动、媒体、日历及投递结果，需与同名网红营销或网站社会认同产品区分。文档流程允许在确认发布／排程前审阅预备内容。

其关键评估问题是：能否在网页或已连接助手中准备内容，同时清楚展示准确账户、媒体及日期。Influence IQ 规划、发布额度及 AI 排程容量是不同机制。聊天结束不取消已保存计划，一个账户成功也不证明所有目的地成功。本研究仅阅读公开文档，未连接账户或发送。

core_features.explanation_en: Adapt text and media before the final review.
core_features.explanation_zh: 最终审阅前调整文字及媒体。

core_features.explanation_en: Influence IQ uses saved workspace guidance for editable plans.
core_features.explanation_zh: Influence IQ 使用工作区指南创建可编辑计划。

core_features.explanation_en: A connected assistant can prepare reviews under granted scopes.
core_features.explanation_zh: 已连接助手可按所授权限准备审阅。

core_features.explanation_en: Activity tracks delivery; Insights tracks available reporting.
core_features.explanation_zh: Activity 跟踪投递，Insights 跟踪可得报告。

en: Prepare a small business’s channel-specific launch campaign.
Schedule reviewed finished media through a permitted assistant connection.
Investigate delivery and reporting states without automatically duplicating uncertain sends.
zh: 准备小企业渠道专属发布活动。
通过获授权助手连接排程已审完成媒体。
调查投递及报告状态，避免对不明发送自动复制。
use_cases.basis: Editorial workflow examples; not observed customer outcomes.

steps.en: Set brand guidance and select eligible destination accounts.
steps.zh: 设置品牌指南并选择合格目的地账户。

steps.en: Prepare drafts and review exact media, settings and dates.
steps.zh: 准备草稿并检查准确媒体、设置及日期。

steps.en: Check workspace/scopes and remaining AI schedule capacity.
steps.zh: 检查工作区／权限及剩余 AI 排程容量。

steps.en: Confirm the displayed version, then inspect saved and delivery states.
steps.zh: 确认展示版本后查看保存及投递状态。

steps.en: Check native results before replacing an uncertain send.
steps.zh: 替换不明确发送前检查原生结果。

items.en: AI schedules have a separate destination-based rolling cap.
items.zh: AI 排程另有按目的地的滚动上限。

items.en: After delivery starts, ordinary schedule changes are unavailable.
items.zh: 投递开始后普通排程修改不可用。

items.en: A queued Insights refresh does not prove metrics are current.
items.zh: Insights 刷新排队不能证明指标已更新。

items.en: IQ does not generate video/audio, and image tools depend on connection/workspace.
items.zh: IQ 不生成视频／音频，图片工具取决于连接／工作区。

pricing.source_snapshot_en: Starter includes 50 publications/1,500 IQ credits per month; Growth 150/3,750; Pro unlimited publications/7,500 credits. Seven-day trial requires card checkout and bills afterward unless canceled; plan changes can end trial and charge immediately. No permanent free tier verified. Current localized homepage rendered SGD, with duplicated amounts across tier cards and a Growth introductory promotion, so no normalized price assigned. Confirm checkout currency, recurring rate and taxes. Cancellation ends renewal while retaining access through the paid period; disconnecting or deleting content does not cancel it.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: Starter 每月包含 50 次发布／1,500 IQ 点，Growth 150／3,750，Pro 不限发布／7,500 点。7 天试用需银行卡结算，到期未取消即收费，换档可能立即结束试用并收费。未核实永久免费档。当前本地化首页返回 SGD，各卡片重复金额并含 Growth 首期优惠，因此不分配标准化价格。需确认结算币种、续费及税。取消停止续费并保留至已付周期，断开或删除内容不取消订阅。

official_check.scope: Official public documentation only; no purchase, account operation, sending test, identity or publication approval.

review_notes: Original English and corresponding Chinese research draft. Vendor statements describe documented behavior, not independently measured quality.
Existing third-party source is discovery-only and superseded. Unknown UI languages, regional availability and licensing remain unknown.
All publication and alternative-relationship states remain unapproved.

sections.title_en: A campaign groups related posts without making destinations identical
sections.title_zh: 活动组织相关帖子，不要求目的地完全相同
sections.en: Single Post prepares an update, while Campaign groups related content. Each selected account can have its own text and media. The review combines destinations, content and timing; an unfinished draft remains editable. Editorial product-launch example: supply confirmed facts and approved assets, prepare a shorter channel version where needed, then inspect each destination instead of assuming shared campaign membership validates every format. Official example screenshots use fictional data and do not demonstrate an actual customer result.
sections.zh: Single Post 准备一条更新，Campaign 组织相关内容，每个所选账户可有独立文字媒体。审阅集中目的地、内容及时间，未完成草稿仍可编辑。编辑产品发布示例：提供已确认事实及获准素材，按需准备较短渠道版本，再逐目的地检查，不能假设属于同一活动就验证了每种格式。官方示例截图使用虚构数据，不能证明客户真实效果。

sections.title_en: Saved review and permission to publish are different
sections.title_zh: 已保存审阅与发布许可不同
sections.en: The publishing guide requires a final confirmation after reviewing the exact account, links, media, settings, time and timezone. An IQ plan may contain both drafts and scheduled entries: drafts stay unpublished while approved scheduled entries deliver at their chosen times. Upcoming supports cancellation/rescheduling only before delivery starts and when the controls are available; canceling retains the campaign record. Editorial acceptance: check the saved schedule and later per-account Activity, rather than treating preparation, approval and publication as the same event.
sections.zh: 发布指南要求检查准确账户、链接、媒体、设置、时间及时区后最终确认。IQ 计划可同时包含草稿及计划项，草稿不发布，批准的计划项按所选时间投递。Upcoming 仅在投递开始前且控件可用时支持取消／改期，取消保留活动记录。编辑验收建议：查看已保存计划及之后各账户 Activity，不能把准备、批准、发布当作同一事件。

sections.title_en: Image generation has its own cost and review step
sections.title_zh: 图片生成有独立费用及审阅步骤
sections.en: Influence IQ uses saved Brand Guidelines and a concrete brief to prepare and revise plans. Text work uses credits after confirmation. Enabled image generation shows a quote before starting; inspecting and attaching the result still does not approve the post. The separate Claude connection omits image-generation tools, while compatible full connections may offer them. IQ does not generate video or audio. Editorial creative review: check the actual generated image and claims before attaching it, and treat private ad feedback as creative assessment rather than proof of conversions.
sections.zh: Influence IQ 使用已保存品牌指南及具体简报准备、修订计划，文字工作确认后消耗点数。启用的图片生成开始前报价，检查并附加结果仍不等于批准帖子。独立 Claude 连接不含图片生成工具，兼容完整连接可能提供。IQ 不生成视频或音频。编辑创意审阅建议：附加前检查真实图片及主张，把私有广告反馈作为创意评价，不能当作转化证明。

sections.title_en: Check workspace identity and destination permission in the assistant
sections.title_zh: 在助手中检查工作区身份及目的地权限
sections.en: Assistant setup selects an Influence workspace and scopes: media upload needs media write, scheduling needs post write and read-only stays read-only. The client must actually access a file or reachable HTTPS link. Review can use an in-chat card or a complete displayed version followed by fresh explicit approval; edits require a new review. The guide supports batches up to 10 posts/50 deliveries. Editorial setup: verify identity and a controlled draft before broad scheduling. A client connection does not grant access to every local file.
sections.zh: 助手连接选择 Influence 工作区及权限：上传需媒体写权，排程需帖子写权，只读保持只读。客户端需实际能访问文件或可达 HTTPS 链接。审阅可用聊天卡片，或展示完整版本后取得新的明确批准；修改需重审。指南支持最多 10 帖／50 次投递批次。编辑设置建议：大范围排程前检查身份及可控草稿。连接不授予全部本地文件访问。

sections.title_en: AI scheduling uses a separate rolling destination allowance
sections.title_zh: AI 排程另用滚动目的地额度
sections.en: The shared workspace 24-hour AI scheduling cap is Starter 20, Growth 50, Pro 100 destinations. Three accounts consume three slots; WhatsApp recipients count individually. Rescheduling/retrying the same destination does not recount, cancellation does not restore capacity, and an oversized set schedules none. Manual web scheduling, ordinary API/CLI, drafts and publish-now are excluded from this cap; other plan limits remain. Editorial queue plan: check both this capacity and the calendar-month publication allowance before approving a batch.
sections.zh: 工作区共享 24 小时 AI 排程上限：Starter 20、Growth 50、Pro 100 个目的地。三个账户消耗三个位置，WhatsApp 逐收件人计。相同目的地重排／重试不重计，取消不退额度，整组超额则全组不排程。手工网页排程、普通 API／CLI、草稿及立即发布不使用此上限，但其他限制仍适用。编辑队列规划：批准批次前同时检查该容量及日历月发布额度。

sections.title_en: Use the connection’s format constraints before scheduling
sections.title_zh: 排程前使用连接的格式约束
sections.en: The Instagram guide requires an eligible professional account and publishing permission. A single supported non-Story video becomes a Reel; a carousel accepts up to 10 combined images/videos, with ordered attachments. A caption without media cannot publish through this connection. Editorial product carousel: verify the authorized account, attachment sequence and caption against the real assets, then review changes again before scheduling. These are Influence’s documented connection limits, not a verified universal limit for every Instagram integration.
sections.zh: Instagram 指南要求合格专业账户及发布权限。一个支持的非 Story 视频作为 Reel，Carousel 最多混合十张图片／视频，附件有顺序。该连接不能发布只有说明而无媒体的内容。编辑产品轮播建议：按真实素材检查授权账户、附件顺序及说明，修改后在排程前重审。这是 Influence 文档连接限制，不是全部 Instagram 集成的普遍限制验证。

sections.title_zh: 不确定投递会停止自动尝试
sections.en: Troubleshooting says uncertain results stop automatic attempts to avoid duplication. Check Activity and the native destination before replacing content; a confirmed failure can require reconnecting or correcting the campaign. A delivery already started cannot be rescheduled/canceled through the scheduling controls. Ambiguous or nonexistent daylight-saving local times can also require choosing another time. Editorial incident check: distinguish a failed connection, invalid payload and unclear send, then apply the displayed recovery advice. A timeout alone does not prove that nothing was published.
sections.zh: 故障指南说不确定结果会停止自动尝试以避免重复。替换内容前查看 Activity 及原生目的地，确认失败后可能需重连或修正活动。投递已开始不能通过排程控件改期／取消。夏令时导致重复或不存在的本地时刻也可能需另选时间。编辑故障检查：区分连接失败、载荷无效及发送结果不明，按显示建议恢复。单纯超时不证明没有发布。

sections.title_en: Queued refresh is not fresh reporting
sections.title_zh: 刷新排队不等于报告已更新
sections.en: Insights coverage depends on provider, permissions and reporting period. Read the last successful update and account/date range; a collection count need not represent the entire account, and missing data is unknown rather than zero. An assistant refresh returning Queued only acknowledges the request. Reconnecting an assistant does not grant social-provider permission. Editorial report: label stale or unsupported fields and inspect refresh completion before comparing periods. Delivery results and performance metrics answer different questions; neither proves incremental revenue by itself.
sections.zh: Insights 覆盖受平台、权限及报告期影响，应查看最后成功更新时间、账户及日期范围。集合计数不一定代表全部账户，缺失是未知而非零。助手刷新返回 Queued 仅表示请求已提交，重连助手不增加社交平台权限。编辑报告建议：标注陈旧／不支持字段，比较前检查刷新完成。投递结果与效果指标回答不同问题，两者都不能独立证明增量收入。

sections.title_en: Publication and IQ credits reset on different clocks
sections.title_zh: 发布次数与 IQ 点数按不同时钟重置
sections.en: Billing counts a post to three channels as three publications. Publication quotas reset by UTC calendar month; included IQ credits expire each subscription month. Extra credits never expire but need an active plan, and annual billing does not deposit a full year at once. There is no automatic overage charge. Editorial budget: count destinations and AI drafting separately; an apparently unused annual credit balance cannot be assumed available for unrestricted publication.
sections.zh: 账单把三渠道的一帖算作三次发布。发布额度按 UTC 日历月重置，包含的 IQ 点在每个订阅月到期。另购点数不失效但需活动计划，年付不一次发放全年点数，不自动收超额费。编辑预算建议：分别统计目的地与 AI 草稿；不能把看似未用的年度点数余额理解为可无限发布。

seo.title_en: Influence.so: reviewed AI campaigns, scheduling limits and recovery
seo.title_zh: Influence.so：AI 活动审阅、排程限制及恢复
seo.description_en: Examine Influence campaign review, assistant scopes, destination caps, IQ credits, uncertain delivery and Insights freshness.
seo.description_zh: 核对 Influence 活动审阅、助手权限、目的地上限、IQ 点数、不明投递及 Insights 新鲜度。
seo.primary_intent: Evaluate Influence.so AI-assisted social campaign publishing
seo.query_basis: Editorial intent; no search volume, ranking or AI visibility measured.

research_gaps.en: Complete provider/format coverage, approval-role hierarchy, audit retention, retry timing/idempotency contract, regional access and UI-language list remain unverified.
research_gaps.zh: 全部平台／格式、审批角色层级、审计保留、重试时间／幂等契约、地区访问及界面语言清单未核实。

research_gaps.en: Source licence and self-hosting remain unknown; documentation and footer asset licences do not establish a licence for the hosted platform.
research_gaps.zh: 源码许可及自托管未知，文档／页脚素材许可不能确定托管平台许可。

research_gaps.en: No assistant connection, file upload, image generation, paid trial, publication or independent quality/outcome measurement was executed.
research_gaps.zh: 未连接助手、上传文件、生成图片、参加付费试用、发布或独立测量质量／效果。
